name: com.ethar.uxtraining
description: Headset-agnostic XR training UX kit: themed, runtime-built uGUI (world-space step forms, palm-up hand menu, world labels with leader-line connectors), pointer interaction and UX feedback built purely on the Unity Input System with generic <XRController> bindings — Meta Quest, Magic Leap 2 or any OpenXR headset. Drive it from any detection or state source via TrainingStepView.
